title: Festive Energy vs Rest-of-Year Baseline
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=festive:lights OR sourcetype=ecowitt:obs)
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(if(sourcetype=="festive:lights",kwh,0))) as festive_kwh by _time
| eventstats avg(festive_kwh) as yearly_avg
| eval spike=round(festive_kwh-yearly_avg,1)
| sort - festive_kwh
description: Compares your festive-season electricity use against the rest of the year, quantifying the holiday spike.
value: Seeing December light up on the energy chart is amusing and a gentle reminder of seasonal costs.
implementation: Ingest festive energy into `index=personal`; compare the holiday months to your baseline.
visualization: Column chart of festive energy versus yearly average.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how much extra electricity the festive season uses versus the rest of the year.
